title: Payment Portal Terms for Placed Consumer Accounts: Paying from the Consumer's Own Bank Account
content:
Payment portal terms for **Placed Consumer Accounts** covering a bank-debit payment the consumer makes from their own bank account through Ridgeline's payment portal.

## Terms

When a consumer asks to pay the most an account will accept in one day and chooses to pay from their own bank account, the consumer makes one bank-debit payment through the payment portal equal to the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day, posted on the handling date with the portal's confirmation as its reference.

| Element | Term |
|---|---|
| Situation | The consumer wants to pay the largest amount the placed account will take that day, from their own bank account |
| Who makes the payment | The consumer, through the payment portal |
| Number of payments | One bank-debit payment |
| Amount | The portal bank-debit ceiling of the day |
| Booking | Dated the handling date, carrying the portal's confirmation as its reference |

## When the ceiling is fixed

When a consumer who also offers a credit card asks to pay the most an account will accept in one day, the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day is not fixed until the day's credit-card payment has been taken by the phone desk.

Said the other way round: for a consumer who offers a credit card as well, the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day stays open for as long as the day's credit-card payment by the phone desk has not been taken.

## The portal bank payment tool

**Capability.** `make_portal_bank_payment_436b09cd` is the consumer's own payment through Ridgeline's payment portal from their own bank account toward one placed consumer account. The portal debits the consumer's bank account once for the amount entered; the payment is booked on the account's money history as a consumer payment received that day through the bank-debit channel, with the portal confirmation as its reference, and the account's balance due is reduced by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, entering the values. The agent does not make the payment on the consumer's behalf.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The Ridgeline account reference number of the placed consumer account being paid, as given to the consumer by the agent from the placed-account lookup. | Identifier, as recorded |
| `amount` | The payment amount debited from the consumer's bank account. | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; kept to 2 decimal places on receipt, and the balance due is reduced by exactly that amount |

**Return.** The consumer sees on screen:
- `status`: "posted" when the payment was booked; the payment has gone through when the receipt shows status posted;
- `payment_reference`: the portal confirmation number of this payment;
- `account_id`: the account reference paid;
- `amount`: the amount posted, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_channel`: always `ach_bank_debit`;
- `posted_date`: the date the payment was received, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `balance_due_after`: the balance due after this payment, USD to 2 decimal places, or null when the account reference was not found.

The payment then appears in the account's money history dated that day.
